What the real system must prove

Not magic. A chain of receipts.

The impressive part is not making a page. It is preserving intent from buyer criteria through payment, build, route, and outcome.

  1. Dynamic, not cannedThe plan changes with the matter, states, capacity, delivery method, channels, and budget.
  2. QuickBooks is the money railA verified paid invoice starts work. An unpaid draft never does.
  3. Every campaign is versionedThe exact approved criteria remain attached to every generated asset and routing decision.
  4. Paid does not mean ungovernedCompliance and QA gates stay between printing and production traffic.
  5. PROVEN becomes LOCKEDA receipt-backed route stays frozen; material changes become a new candidate and re-prove from zero.
